headline: ED SHEERAN 🍒 TOUR 🚌 FANS 🎟️ LEFT TORN 😣 BY MACKLEMORE 🗣️ DRAMA 🔥
text:
ED 🍒 SHEERAN'S massive 📈 Loop Tour 🚍 has been YEETED 😵 into full DAMAGE 💥 CONTROL MODE 🛠️ after the snowballing ☃️ CONTROVERSY over pro-Palestinian 🇵🇸 rapper 🎤 MACKLEMORE getting straight DROPPED 🙅 as support act 🎸 and now the whole tour 🚌 is PLUNGED 🏊‍♂️ into crisis 😱 leaving concert-goers 🎫 stuck smack in the middle 🧍 of the fraught Israel-Gaza debate 🕊️!! Fans 👥 who spilled 💬 to the BBC 📻 including those clutching 📍 tickets 🎟️ for Sheeran's next show 🎤 have been completely SPLIT 🪓 ever since Macklemore was booted 🚪 from the Loop Tour 🌀 this week after his "free Palestine" protest 🪧 on stage 🎤!! All of Sheeran's opening acts 🎸 have since QUIT 🙅‍♂️ in SOLIDARITY 🤝 leaving the ginger 🍊 icon totally exposed 🫣 and fans like Damien Given 🧔 saying he's still TORN 🥐 on whether he'll even show up 🏟️ for Saturday's gig 🎸 calling Sheeran's response straight DISINGENUOUS 🤥 and labeling the mess a total "no-win situation" 🚫!!

Since the controversy 💣 BLEW UP 💥 earlier this week ticket prices 💰 for his remaining shows 🎫 across the US 🇺🇸 Mexico 🇲🇽 and South America 🌎 have TANKED 📉 hard as boycott calls 📢 spread like wildfire 🔥 and Sheeran himself clapped back 🗣️ saying he's been "appalled by the conflict between Israel and Palestine" 😢 but he would NOT be drawn into any political debate 🏛️!! He argued 🎤 that "those who come to my shows do not expect a political forum" 🫥 and stressed he was NOT responsible 🙅 for Macklemore being REMOVED 🗑️ from the tour 🚫 yet the BACKLASH 😡 has been raining down ☔ from ALL sides 🌍 with some fans furious the tour is rolling on 🎢 without the listed acts 🎤 and now demanding full refunds 💸 because it's no longer the show they paid for 🎟️!!

Damien Given 🧔 from Northern Ireland 🇮🇪 told the BBC 📻 he's felt in two minds 🧠 about the tickets 🎫 he holds for Saturday's Philadelphia show 🏙️ which marks Sheeran's first time back on stage 🎤 since the controversy absolutely SPIRALLED 🌀 and Given feels Macklemore was treated "very very wrong" ❌ while Sheeran wasn't being transparent 🙈 with fans at all!! He pointed out 🫵 that Sheeran said he was in support of Ukraine 🇺🇦 when that war kicked off 💥 so you can't just suddenly flip and say "I'm not political" 🤨 which left Given and his late wife Kellie 👩‍❤️‍👨 with that deep connection to the song Thinking Out Loud 🎶 that played as their first dance 💃 at their wedding 💒 even though she was battling ALS 🦽 and could barely walk 🚶‍♀️ before she sadly passed four years later in 2024 😔!!

Given admitted if it wasn't for that emotional tether 🪢 to Sheeran's music 🎵 he would absolutely skip the show 🚫 but right now he's probably LEANING 🏋️ towards actually going 🎟️ while fellow fan Patti Ann 👩 said she's felt way less conflicted and backs Sheeran 100% 💯 for his decision because he has an obligation 📜 and a contract 📝 with the venues 🏟️ and sometimes financially 💰 you simply can't wiggle out of those types of things!! Ann who's been a Sheeran stan 🧑‍🎤 for years thinks a concert venue 🎸 is absolutely NOT the place for politics 🗳️ so believe what you want 🌍 just don't press it on me 🙅‍♀️ and she is still planning to hit up his Atlanta show 🏟️ in October 🍂 without missing a beat 🎵!!

Matt Jaye 🧔 a Jewish-American from Florida 🌴 was straight OUTRAGED 😤 watching Macklemore's comments 🗣️ on that New Jersey stage 🗽 earlier this month backing Palestine 🇵🇸 so he hit up Ticketmaster 🎟️ begging for a refund on his November Tampa tickets 🏖️ but got denied ❌ which left him pretty upset 😠 until Macklemore was finally removed 🗑️ from Sheeran's lineup 🎤 and Jaye said he's not in favor of any one-sided presentation 🎤 from an artist because that's not why he's going to the concert 🕺!! Jaye believes Sheeran bears some culpability 🧾 for letting that pro-Palestinian protest 🪧 happen and if he's claiming to be apolitical 🧘 then he should maintain those same standards 📏 for every artist he brings on 🎸 adding that he would have loved an apology 🙇 to the Jewish community ✡️ for making part of the audience super uncomfortable 😣!!

Heather Park 👩 who has tickets 🎟️ this very weekend is now worried 😟 some shows might get straight CANCELLED ❌ before Sheeran rolls into her city 🏙️ but her main goal 🎯 was always just to see Ed Sheeran 🍊 live while Macklemore was merely a bonus 🎁 and even though she thinks his ouster was unfair ⚖️ and a violation of free speech 🗣️ she's mostly unbothered by all the drama 🌀 preferring to separate the artist 🎤 from the art 🎨 because at the end of the day she still likes the music 🎶!!
